summary: The missions list joins person-read, and a new projection-fresh target times each missions, agents and attention publication from the commit it carries

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; no client contract change. slo/targets.toml gains a projection-fresh latency target and the missions list paths under person-read; a target path may now be publish COLLECTION.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/request-latency, st slo ls and st doctor show one more target, projection-fresh, and its publish missions, publish agents and publish attention paths. Targets describe and gate nothing.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. Each publication that advances its cut reads one indexed claims range for the first claim this node committed after the previous cut.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
